title: The Orchestra of Spoons
youtube_title: The Orchestra of Spoons | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Two careful pairs of hands can do what one rush cannot.
summary: At a harbor dock where baskets are passed up, a spoons that could be a band if the rhythm was shared will go wrong if one person rushes. Dori and Milo split it into two slow jobs, while Uncle Idris only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
